title: Story bed: tension
description: A celli ostinato, a ticking woodblock and low piano octaves; the pulse, violas tremolo and the motif's tail from bar 8; high violins, tom rolls and a swell from bar 16.
usage: Loops seamlessly. -26 LUFS-S with a 1-4 kHz pocket for the narration; duck it with scripts/audio/duck.py. All four story beds share 75 BPM, so they can be switched on a bar line (every 3.2 s).
instruments: VSCO 2 celli (fast), basses, violas tremolo, violins
VCSL woodblock, toms, bass drum, cymbal swell
selfReview: A celli ostinato with phrygian Eb neighbours, a woodblock clock and low piano octaves; the pulse, violas tremolo and the motif's tail from bar 8; high violins and tom rolls from bar 16. The short Eb-over-D rubs are the intended tension. It passes with a modest voice pocket.
